blocking: The independently positioned logo morph can cross the still-visible hero descriptor during intermediate scroll positions, violating the no-overlap rule.
On short phone viewports, the bottom-anchored hero content can extend into the fixed header; the 600px minimum does not reserve space for the rendered text.
The mobile no-JavaScript navigation fallback expands over the hero instead of reserving layout space.

fixes.what: Coordinate the morph with the descriptor and tagline: fade those lines completely before the moving logo reaches their bounds, or change its trajectory to maintain clearance. Check intermediate scroll positions, not just endpoints.
fixes.why: The logo moves upward more slowly than the text beneath it, allowing their visible rectangles to intersect.

fixes.what: Reserve header clearance plus the actual hero content height before placing the canopy. Increase the effective hero height when necessary; verify 390×600, landscape and enlarged text.
fixes.why: Anchoring the content bottom to 52% of the hero protects foliage clearance but leaves its top unconstrained.

fixes.what: Put the fallback navigation in normal flow and account for its height in the hero placement; keep contact rows inside the enhanced drawer or a compact fallback disclosure.
fixes.why: The absolute fallback includes navigation and contact rows but reserves no space beneath the header.

fixes.what: Explicitly clear the inline transform on .logo-morph and width on its image during kill(), or register all callback-driven gsap.set calls with the context.
fixes.why: ScrollTrigger callbacks execute after context construction; their repeated gsap.set calls are not reliably covered by the existing context cleanup.

fixes.what: Apply the tab's reserved right gutter to every inner-page content container where it can appear, including section headings, jump links and .options__note; verify while scrolling upward.
fixes.why: The current selector list protects selected paragraphs but leaves other text exposed to the fixed 36px tab.
